variants.headline: The colony has voted
variants.sub: The colony has held its election to the Colonial Assembly.
variants.body:
An election to the Colonial Assembly has been held in {colony}. The event places representation at the centre of public attention. The assessment of {target} should distinguish the holding of an election from any claim about what its result authorises.

Our movement regards representation as a duty, not a decoration to be worn until the next campaign. A ballot matters because political convictions should have a route into public decisions. Those who seek support ought to remember the purpose for which that support is sought.

We regard {target} favourably in this assessment. Participation in representative politics deserves a fair hearing, and an election should be an occasion for reasoned judgment rather than reflexive hostility. Political principle should remain visible when judgment becomes less comfortable.

variants.headline: Ballots before the business of government
variants.sub: Voting in an election to the Colonial Assembly has taken place.
